result.target_topic: Strategic narrowing of consumer activities via divestitures and transitions
result.target_summary: Goldman Sachs narrowed its focus on consumer-related activities in 2023 and 2024 by completing the sale of the Marcus loan portfolio, its PFM business, and the majority of the GreenSky loan portfolio, as well as selling its seller financing loan portfolio. In 2024, the company also agreed to transition the GM credit card program to another issuer, expected to complete in Q3 2025, while committing to support products and customers during these transitions.

target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures relate to the narrowing of consumer-related activities. gs_2023_7_D103 specifically mentions the sale of the Marcus loans portfolio. gs_2024_7_D194 lists this sale as one of the actions taken to narrow focus, along with PFM and GreenSky sales. While gs_2024_7_D194 is broader, it is the specific 2024 disclosure that confirms the status/outcome of the Marcus sale mentioned in 2023.

gs_2023_7_D117 mentions the sale of GreenSky and the transition of the GM credit card program. gs_2024_7_D194 lists the sale of GreenSky and the agreement to transition the GM credit card program as part of the narrowing of consumer focus. This is the same specific strategic topic.

comparisons.peer_summary: Citi significantly reduced its consumer loan portfolio in Russia through portfolio sales and a credit card referral agreement with a Russian bank.
comparisons.comparison: Similar to Goldman Sachs' strategic narrowing of consumer activities through divestitures and transitions, Citigroup significantly reduced its consumer loan portfolio in Russia via sales and structural changes (credit card referral agreement). Both disclosures highlight a deliberate reduction or restructuring of specific consumer loan exposures, whereas Goldman Sachs focused on North American consumer brands (Marcus, GreenSky) and Citi focused on a specific geographic legacy franchise (Russia).

sentences.text: During 2023 and 2024, we narrowed our focus with respect to consumer-related activities by taking the following actions:
• We sold the majority of the GreenSky loan portfolio in 2023 and, during 2024, completed the sale of GreenSky (included within Platform Solutions).

In addition, Citi significantly reduced its All Other-Legacy Franchises consumer loan portfolio in Russia (reported as part of Asia Consumer), largely due to loan portfolio sales and its entry into a credit card referral agreement with a Russian bank.

comparisons.peer_topic: Consumer Credit Portfolio Composition and Strategy
comparisons.peer_summary: The firm's retained consumer portfolio primarily serves the prime segment and consists of residential real estate, credit card, scored auto, and business banking loans. Originated mortgages are typically securitized or sold, while other consumer loans are retained on the balance sheet.
comparisons.comparison: While Goldman Sachs is actively divesting consumer assets to narrow its focus, JPMorgan describes a strategy of selectively retaining specific prime consumer loans (residential real estate, credit card) while selling originated mortgages. Both companies manage consumer credit portfolios but demonstrate opposite tactical approaches in 2024: GS is shrinking the scope of consumer holdings through exit, while JPM is maintaining a specific subset of consumer loans while continuing to sell originated mortgages.

sentences.text: During 2023 and 2024, we narrowed our focus with respect to consumer-related activities by taking the following actions:
• During 2024, we sold our seller financing loan portfolio (included within Platform Solutions). This portfolio consisted of loans that were extended to small- and medium-sized retailers.
The Firm's retained consumer portfolio consists primarily of loans and lending-related commitments for residential real estate, credit card, scored auto and business banking.

Originated mortgage loans are retained in the residential real estate portfolio, securitized or sold to U.S. government agencies and U.S. government-sponsored enterprises; other types of consumer loans are typically retained on the balance sheet.

peer_results.rationale: Morgan Stanley's candidates describe its Wealth Management lending products (residential real estate, securities-based lending) and their classification as held-for-investment. This describes existing product lines rather than a strategic divestiture, narrowing, or exit of consumer activities comparable to Goldman Sachs' actions.
